title: Points of Judgement in Working Out a Workplace Cafe Management Program Closing Settlement
content:
When a workplace cafe management contract held under the Workplace Cafe Management Program is settled out, the client pays one closing settlement that clears the contract in a single document.

#### What is carried in from the contract

The unsettled balance carried into the settlement is the amount invoiced and not yet settled standing on the contract. The contract year elapsed is the whole months between the first day of the contract term and the day the settlement is worked out, reduced by whole years.

#### The amounts taken and the shares they are taken at

The opening inventory recovery is nil, being 0 per cent of the opening inventory printed against the service model. The equipment deposit returned is the whole refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model, that is 100 per cent of it, rounded to the nearest cent. The drawable subsidy funding refunded is the subsidy funding balance standing on the contract. The carry-over share is the nil carry-over share, 0 per cent. The smallwares share is nil, 0 per cent.

#### The two proportioned amounts

The smallwares allowance credited back is the smallwares allowance printed against the service model taken at the smallwares share and then reduced to the proportion that the whole months of the contract year still to run bear to twelve, rounded to the nearest cent; the whole months still to run are twelve less the contract year elapsed.

The drawable subsidy funding paid back is what is left of the drawable subsidy funding refunded once the carry-over share is taken off it, rounded to the nearest cent.

#### The settlement itself

The settlement is recorded against the billing period in which it is paid. The closing settlement is the unsettled balance carried into the settlement, plus the opening inventory recovery, less the equipment deposit returned, less the drawable subsidy funding refunded after any carry-over, and less the smallwares allowance credited back; the result is rounded to the nearest cent and is never less than nil.

#### Worked through on hypothetical inputs

Every figure in this walk-through is hypothetical and none of it is a figure of any service model or client.

| Point | Hypothetical input | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Unsettled balance carried into the settlement | invoiced and not yet settled on the contract | 18400.00 USD |
| Contract year elapsed | term first day 2023-05-01, settlement worked out 2025-11-18, so 30 whole months reduced by whole years | 6 months |
| Whole months of the contract year still to run | twelve less the contract year elapsed | 6 months |
| Opening inventory recovery | nil | 0.00 USD |
| Equipment deposit returned | a hypothetical refundable equipment deposit of 9000.00 USD printed against the service model, taken whole | 9000.00 USD |
| Drawable subsidy funding refunded | subsidy funding balance standing on the contract | 7200.00 USD |
| Drawable subsidy funding paid back | what is left once the nil carry-over share is taken off it, rounded to the nearest cent | 7200.00 USD |
| Smallwares allowance credited back | a hypothetical smallwares allowance of 4800.00 USD taken at the nil smallwares share and then reduced to 6 twelfths, rounded to the nearest cent | 0.00 USD |

On those hypothetical inputs the closing settlement is 18400.00 USD plus 0.00 USD less 9000.00 USD less 7200.00 USD less 0.00 USD, which is 2200.00 USD once rounded to the nearest cent, and being above nil it stands as the amount the client pays.
